core.headline: Brand-new 3-bed semi with air source heat pump, Kings Hill
core.summary: A contemporary 3-bedroom semi-detached house forming part of the Orchard Rise development in Kings Hill. Air source heat pump, underfloor heating downstairs, EV charging point, two allocated parking spaces and a 10-year NHBC warranty.
core.listing:
Plot 47 is a brand-new 3-bedroom semi-detached house with an EV charging point, two allocated parking spaces and a 10-year NHBC warranty. Completion is expected spring 2027. The property is heated via an air source heat pump with underfloor heating to the ground floor and radiators upstairs. The principal bedroom benefits from an en-suite.

The ground floor comprises a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10") and a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2"). The principal bedroom measures 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10"). Outside, there is a turfed rear garden with a patio.

Kings Hill is located approximately 2 miles from West Malling station.

Fixed Price £410,000. Freehold. Council tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating: B (predicted rating based on SAP; the final EPC will be issued on completion). Construction: Standard – brick and block under a tiled roof. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage. Heating: air source heat pump; underfloor heating downstairs, radiators upstairs. Broadband: FTTP. Parking: two allocated spaces; EV charging point. No onward chain.

Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026.

Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
